title: Removing a fixed amplification in exact C*-algebras
exact_target: If C is an exact complex C*-algebra and one fixed integer $n\geq 1$ makes $h^{\oplus n}$ properly infinite for every $h\in C_+$, must each h itself be properly infinite and C strongly purely infinite? Consequently, in the separable nuclear setting does this fixed-amplification hypothesis imply absorption of $O\infty $?

sources.citation: OpenAI, manuscript citation page. Source of the formulation motivating this local problem.
